items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: I was working, working there, helping, helping, uh, Howard Boris.

ctx.x: So he would have been the one at Trent G.

He's the guy, he played in the pit that too. Oh, yeah? And Zutty played, Zutty played, played drums with that, and Happy played first drums with the, with the band. And Zutty, that story, the story brings me back. I was working, working there, helping, helping, uh, Howard Boris. He was selling the musical instrument with that Whirline music store, see? Mm-hmm.
